integrity_statement: Recurrence evaluated independently by a self-contained Python recursive verifier and a bottom-up C++17 verifier, with their parsed outputs agreeing exactly. Graph definitions are provided as source. No external independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Exact certificate for five finite graph skeletons only. The octahedral (2,3) pair is covered by the founding paper and is not claimed as novel; the dual dodecahedral and icosahedral outcomes and second-response profiles are the substantive contribution. Absolute priority remains uncertain.
title: Exact matching-saturation game values and second-response rigidity on the five Platonic graphs
